title: Persuasion (PAP) Jailbreak Effectiveness Replicated as a Persuasion-Technique Ablation on Open Models

original_idea.body:
# Persuasion (PAP) Jailbreak Effectiveness Replicated as a Persuasion-Technique Ablation on Open Models

**Problem:** The relative potency of each PAP persuasion technique on open models is not consolidated.

**Direction:** Replicate PAP on 2-3 open instruct models using its public persuasion techniques. Report per-technique ASR ranking per model and test whether the ranking is stable across models/sizes.

**Why it matters:** Maps which fluent social-engineering strategies are most dangerous for open models.

**Relevant context:** PAP 'How Johnny Can Persuade LLMs to Jailbreak Them' (chats-lab).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (mapping dangerous persuasion strategies) but a present-day misuse taxonomy with a gap to catastrophic risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Apply fixed public persuasion templates + open scorer; accessible, no optimization.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped per-technique ASR ranking with a stability check.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-model persuasion-jailbreak taxonomy labs deprioritize; external-friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only on 2-3 open models, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: PAP already enumerated 40 techniques with ASR; this is largely consolidation/replication on open models.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: PAP already established per-technique ASR; open-model replication is incremental.
